timebase: seconds on the FINAL voice (478.4 s, voiceovers/ep06_voice.mp3). Beat offsets: B1 0, B2 22.68, B3 46.10, B4 80.22, B5 119.47, B6 165.10, B7 205.92, B8 237.34, B9 273.18, B10 295.30, B11 320.36, B12 340.06, B13 374.69, B14 404.76, B15 455.41. Line times = renders/ep06_hi_exact.srt (exact). from.a = w (word onset from build/ep06/timings.json + beat offset), l (SRT line start/end), g (placed in a voice gap). NOTE: episodes/ep06/voice_timeline.md (606.6 s) is STALE (older/padded) and was NOT used.
levels: gain_db: bed/ambience = RMS dBFS in a gap, all other roles = peak dBFS in a gap. Under speech the renderer ducks each cue by duck_db (role default: bed -14, motif -14, ostinato -15, pulse -15, ambience -16, riser -15, hit -12, sfx -12) using the real voice envelope (60 ms look-ahead, 400 ms release, holes shorter than 0.3 s stay ducked).

brahma.note: four faces = four rising notes. Grand in B4, brass/ego in B3 and B10, lost and slowed in B5, weary cello descent [8,5,3,1] in B7 and B14

shiva.note: low, slow; full in B11-B13, receding in B14

ketaki.note: a falling petal; distorted (reversed) when it lies in B9, last bell at its curse in B13

pillar.note: cluster C-Db-G that never resolves while the pillar stands

daksha.note: grief that turns to fire; seeds the next episode
